title: Prevent accidental device re-pairing and preserve supervised agent connectivity.
changes: Block remcp connect on a computer already paired, before a new code can rotate its device credentials; require explicit --re-pair for intentional recovery or transfer.
Reject a workspace pairing claim for an existing machine unless the client expressly confirms re-pairing; retain the one-time code when the request is rejected.
Reload the managed macOS, Linux or Windows agent after an approved credential change so the running service does not remain Offline with its previous token.
Preserve account ownership boundaries and stable machine identity; verify pairing, service restart, security and isolated PostgreSQL regression suites.
Ship client and runtime as one public release before updating the private server; never deploy unpublished client changes.
